name: better-colors
title_zh: 色板、令牌、对比度一次问清的调色盘管家
tagline_zh: 从随手取色到全站语义令牌，不用再开三个工具来回切。问它“这个绿配什么字色能过 AA”，它直接给你算好答案。
tagline_en: Stop juggling three tools for picking, converting, and checking colors. Ask it if that green passes AA with your.
desc_en: Helps you build a color system and answer anything about color in your project. You can generate palettes, use semantic tokens, convert between formats, check contrast and more.
why_zh: 把色彩知识变成可对话的工程资产：色板生成、格式互转、对比度校验共用同一套上下文，问得越细答得越准。
why_en: Turns color knowledge into a conversational asset: palettes, format conversion, and contrast checks share one context, so.
limit_zh: 只处理颜色相关问答，不负责把令牌写进你的代码文件；对比度按 WCAG 算，不认品牌自定义的“看着舒服”标准。
limit_en: Color questions only; won't write tokens into your codebase. Contrast follows WCAG, not your brand's 'looks fine' standard.
title_en: A color system copilot: palettes, tokens, contrast in one.
